SELECT COUNT(*) AS SilverCount
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK '/bronze/well/2026-08-27/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'aer_adls',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS b
WHERE UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NOT NULL
  AND UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT <> ''
  AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE, 112) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10,2)) >= 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS QuarantineCount
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK '/bronze/well/2026-08-27/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'aer_adls',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS b
WHERE UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NULL
   OR UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT = ''
   OR TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE, 112) IS NULL
   OR TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 0
   OR (
        WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH IS NOT NULL
        AND TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10,2)) IS NULL
      );
